NAME:
   rancher create cluster - Create a provisioning cluster (--import, --custom, or --machine-config for a node-driver cluster)

USAGE:
   rancher create cluster [flags] <name>

FLAGS:
   --cloud-credential id       cloud credential id for a node-driver cluster; a display name is refused
   --controlplane              machine pool: control-plane role
   --custom                    custom cluster; nodes join separately via a registration command
   --etcd                      machine pool: etcd role
   --help, -h                  show help
   --import                    imported cluster (no RKE config)
   --k8s-version version       Kubernetes version; required for --custom and for a node-driver cluster, optional for --import
   --machine-config kind/name  machine config kind/name for the machine pool of a node-driver cluster; kinds: amazonec2config, azureconfig, digitaloceanconfig, harvesterconfig, vmwarevsphereconfig
   --pool-name string          machine pool name (default: pool1)
   --quantity string           number of nodes in the machine pool (default: 1)
   --worker                    machine pool: worker role

GLOBAL FLAGS:
   --allow-deprecated          allow writing to a deprecated resource
   --apply                     apply the change
   --color string              auto|always|never
   --config string, -c string  path to the config directory [$RANCHER_CLI_CONFIG_DIR]
   --debug                     print telemetry upload details on stderr (development builds)
   --dry-run                   preview the changes without applying them
   --no-input                  never prompt; fail with an error when the input is ambiguous
   --output string, -o string  table|wide|json|yaml|name|template=<go-template>
   --read-only                 refuse commands that make changes in this run; once set it cannot be turned off; local commands do not accept it
   --yes                       confirm a destructive change
